description:
The snowmobile trail is managed through a partnership agreement with the Eagle Valley Snowmobile Club.

For additional info check out their website:
http://sledsicamous.com

Trail fees are in effect throughout the winter operating season (Nov 1 - May 31).

Always check the avalanche conditions before you go. https://www.avalanche.ca/planning/trip-planner
directions: The trailhead is located off the Yard Creek FSR, just off the Yard Creek Loop Road, approximately 17km east of Sicamous.
title: Blue Lake Snowmobile Trails
